generic.Defined scope/population: Current month's Operations Performance Report deck and underlying data extract, all business units.
generic.In-scope period: The most recently closed reporting month.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reporting month, business unit and version number populated on the archived files.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived data extract row counts match the source BI platform export.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archived PDF and extract retain export timestamp and version tag in SharePoint.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing or corrupted archive files logged with cause and re-export status.
generic.Test population: The current reporting month's archived report and data extract.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires report, extract and trend workbook all archived and tagged for the period.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing archive items are re-exported and re-filed before period close-out.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Report and extract filed, tagged, and trend workbook updated for the period.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint Performance Reporting archive folder for the reporting period.

steps.title: Export the report deck and data extract from the BI/reporting platform
sop: Open the Operations Performance Report in the BI/reporting platform for the closed month.
Export the report as a PDF deck and export the underlying data extract as a data file.
Save both exports to the working folder using the standard file-naming convention.
Done when the report PDF and data extract are exported and correctly named.
verify: Open the exported PDF and data extract and confirm they reflect the closed reporting month.
Pass when both files open cleanly and show the correct period.

steps.title: File the report and extract in the SharePoint Performance Reporting archive folder
sop: Navigate to the SharePoint Performance Reporting archive folder for the reporting period.
Upload the report PDF and data extract into the period subfolder.
Check the folder listing before upload to confirm no prior-period file will be overwritten.
Done when both files are uploaded to the correct period subfolder.
verify: Open the SharePoint folder and confirm both files are present in the period subfolder.
Pass when the folder listing shows the report PDF and data extract for the period.

steps.title: Tag the archived files with reporting month, business unit and version
sop: Open the SharePoint file properties panel for each archived file.
Set the reporting month, business unit and version number metadata fields.
Save the metadata and confirm it appears in the folder's column view.
Done when both files show the correct metadata tags in the column view.
verify: Filter the SharePoint folder view by reporting month and business unit.
Pass when the filtered view returns the newly archived files.

steps.title: Retire the prior draft version from the working folder
sop: Open the working folder used to draft the report before finalization.
Move the prior draft file into the retired-versions subfolder.
Confirm the working folder now contains only the current in-progress draft.
Done when the prior draft is moved out of the active working folder.
verify: Check the working folder listing after the move.
Pass when no finalized prior-period draft remains in the active folder.

steps.title: Update the multi-year trend workbook with the archived period's figures
sop: Open the multi-year trend workbook stored in the Performance Reporting archive.
Append the current period's KPI figures to the trend workbook's data table.
Refresh the trend workbook's charts so they include the new period.
Done when the trend workbook shows the new period's figures in the table and charts.
verify: Open the refreshed trend workbook and locate the new period's row.
Pass when the new period's figures appear correctly in the trend table and charts.

steps.title: Confirm the archive is complete before closing out the period
sop: Review the SharePoint archive folder checklist for the period.
Confirm the report PDF, data extract and trend workbook update are all present.
Mark the period as archived in the Performance Reporting tracker.
Done when the tracker shows the period as fully archived.
verify: Reopen the tracker and locate the period's archive status.
Pass when the status reads archived with all three items checked.

generic.Defined scope/population: Current divisional KPI set benchmarked against industry peer data for the period.
generic.In-scope period: The current reporting period's KPI results.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each KPI has a division actual, peer median and top-quartile value populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Benchmarked KPI count matches the full divisional KPI set from the dashboard.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Benchmark comparison saved with source-data pull date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: KPIs more than 10% below peer median flagged with follow-up owner.
generic.Test population: All KPIs on the divisional Power BI Operations Performance dashboard.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires every KPI compared to peer median/top-quartile with gaps over 10% flagged.
generic.Exception handling path: Flagged KPIs are routed to the process owner for a follow-up improvement review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Benchmark comparison logged in the Operations Performance Report archive.
generic.Evidence location: Operations Performance Report archive, benchmark comparison subfolder.

steps.title: Pull the current divisional KPI set from the Power BI dashboard
sop: Open the Power BI Operations Performance dashboard for the division.
Export the current-period KPI set to a working spreadsheet.
Confirm the exported KPI list matches the dashboard's published KPI count.
Done when the full divisional KPI set is exported to the working spreadsheet.
verify: Cross-check the exported row count against the dashboard's KPI count.
Pass when the counts match exactly.

steps.title: Source external peer benchmark data for the same KPI set
sop: Locate the current industry survey or vendor benchmarking report covering the same KPIs.
Extract the peer median and top-quartile value for each matching KPI.
Note the benchmark source and publication date alongside each value.
Done when peer median and top-quartile values are captured for every matching KPI.
verify: Confirm each divisional KPI has a corresponding peer benchmark value recorded.
Pass when no in-scope KPI is missing a peer benchmark figure.

steps.title: Build the side-by-side benchmark comparison
sop: Combine the division actual, peer median and top-quartile values into one comparison table.
Calculate the variance of division actual versus peer median for each KPI.
Format the table for inclusion in the Operations Performance Report archive.
Done when the comparison table shows actual, median, top-quartile and variance for every KPI.
verify: Spot-check three KPI rows against the source dashboard and benchmark report.
Pass when the spot-checked values match their source figures.

steps.title: Flag any KPI more than 10% below the peer median
sop: Filter the comparison table for KPIs where the division actual trails the peer median by more than 10%.
Mark each flagged KPI in the tracker with the gap size and affected function.
Route flagged KPIs to the Process Improvement Specialist for follow-up.
Done when every KPI over the 10% threshold is flagged with gap size recorded.
verify: Recompute the variance percentage for each flagged row.
Pass when every flagged KPI is confirmed over the 10% threshold.

steps.title: Log the completed benchmark comparison in the Operations Performance Report archive
sop: Save the finalized benchmark comparison file to the Operations Performance Report archive folder.
Tag the file with the reporting period and division.
Confirm the file is discoverable from the archive's period index.
Done when the comparison is filed and tagged in the archive.
verify: Open the archive folder and locate the newly filed comparison.
Pass when the file is present and correctly tagged for the period.

steps.title: Confirm the completed work is filed and meets acceptance criteria
sop: Open Operations Performance Report archive, benchmark comparison subfolder.
Confirm the required evidence for this task is present and complete.
Review the evidence against the task's documented acceptance criteria.
Done when the evidence is complete and meets the acceptance criteria.
verify: Reopen the evidence location and spot-check the filed evidence.
Pass when the evidence fully satisfies the acceptance criteria.

generic.Defined scope/population: Daily, weekly and monthly performance data from policy admin, billing, servicing and contact-center feeds.
generic.In-scope period: The current reporting day, week or month depending on feed cadence.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Transaction counts, cycle-time and handle-time fields populated for each source feed.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Loaded row counts tie to prior-day row counts within the agreed tolerance.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Load logs retained showing feed name, load timestamp and row count.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missed or incomplete daily loads flagged with cause and resolution status.
generic.Test population: All source feeds scheduled to load for the period (policy admin, billing, servicing, contact center).
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires every scheduled feed loaded and reconciled within tolerance, no missed loads.
generic.Exception handling path: Missed or out-of-tolerance loads are re-run and re-reconciled before the data is used downstream.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reconciled data set loaded into the operations performance schema with no missed feeds.
generic.Evidence location: Enterprise data warehouse operations performance schema load log.

steps.title: Pull transaction and cycle-time data from the source feeds
sop: Open the daily extract jobs for the policy admin, billing and servicing source systems.
Confirm each extract completed and produced a file for the current period.
Stage the extracted files in the load landing area of the data warehouse.
Done when all three source extracts are staged for load.
verify: Check the landing area for a file from each source system for the period.
Pass when all three expected files are present.

steps.title: Reconcile contact-center volume and handle-time against the workforce management export
sop: Pull the contact-center volume and handle-time extract for the period.
Pull the corresponding workforce management export for the same period.
Compare total volume and average handle time between the two sources.
Done when the contact-center extract is reconciled against the workforce management export.
verify: Recompute the variance between the two sources.
Pass when the variance is within the agreed reconciliation tolerance.

steps.title: Load the reconciled data into the Enterprise data warehouse
sop: Run the load job pointing at the staged and reconciled source files.
Monitor the load job to completion in the data warehouse job console.
Capture the resulting row counts per source table.
Done when the load job completes successfully for all source feeds.
verify: Open the job console and confirm the load job status is successful.
Pass when all source tables show a completed load with no errors.

steps.title: Flag any source feed with a missed or incomplete daily load
sop: Compare today's load status against the scheduled feed list.
Identify any feed that did not load or loaded with an incomplete row count.
Log the missed or incomplete feed in the data-load exception tracker with cause.
Done when every missed or incomplete feed is logged with cause.
verify: Review the exception tracker against the day's load status list.
Pass when every non-loaded feed appears in the tracker.

steps.title: Confirm the loaded data ties to the prior day's row counts within tolerance
sop: Compare today's loaded row count per table to the prior day's row count.
Flag any table whose variance exceeds the agreed day-over-day tolerance.
Record the reconciliation result in the operations performance load log.
Done when the day-over-day reconciliation result is recorded for every table.
verify: Review the load log entry for the period.
Pass when all tables are within tolerance or have a logged, dispositioned exception.

steps.title: Confirm the completed work is filed and meets acceptance criteria
sop: Open Enterprise data warehouse operations performance schema load log.
Confirm the required evidence for this task is present and complete.
Review the evidence against the task's documented acceptance criteria.
Done when the evidence is complete and meets the acceptance criteria.
verify: Reopen the evidence location and spot-check the filed evidence.
Pass when the evidence fully satisfies the acceptance criteria.

generic.Defined scope/population: The Power BI dashboard page for the requesting business unit's KPI set.
generic.In-scope period: The current reporting cycle at the agreed refresh cadence.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Dashboard data source, refresh schedule and access permissions all configured.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Dashboard figures match the source operations performance warehouse for a full cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dashboard publish log retained showing version, publish date and validating analyst.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any dashboard figure mismatch logged with root cause before publication.
generic.Test population: One full reporting cycle of dashboard output compared to the source report.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires dashboard figures matching source for the full validation cycle with correct refresh cadence.
generic.Exception handling path: Mismatches are corrected in the data model and revalidated before publish.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dashboard live, refreshing on schedule and validated against source data.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI workspace publish history for the business unit dashboard.

steps.title: Build or update the Power BI dashboard page for the business unit
sop: Open Power BI Desktop and load the business unit's dashboard page.
Add or update visuals to cover the requested KPI set.
Save the updated dashboard file to the shared development workspace.
Done when the dashboard page includes every requested KPI.
verify: Review the dashboard page against the requested KPI list.
Pass when every requested KPI appears as a visual on the page.

steps.title: Connect the dashboard's data source to the operations performance warehouse schema
sop: Open the dashboard's data source settings in Power BI Desktop.
Point the connection at the current operations performance warehouse schema.
Test the connection and confirm data loads without error.
Done when the dashboard successfully connects to the current schema.
verify: Refresh the dashboard manually after connecting.
Pass when the refresh completes without a connection error.

steps.title: Configure the dashboard refresh schedule
sop: Open the dataset settings in the Power BI service.
Set the scheduled refresh to the agreed daily or real-time cadence.
Save the refresh configuration and trigger a manual refresh to confirm it runs.
Done when the refresh schedule is saved and a manual test refresh succeeds.
verify: Check the refresh history in the Power BI service after the test run.
Pass when the refresh history shows a successful run on the configured schedule.

steps.title: Validate dashboard figures against the source report
sop: Compare the dashboard's KPI values to the source operations performance report for one full cycle.
Investigate and resolve any figure that does not match the source.
Repeat the comparison after any correction until figures tie out.
Done when dashboard figures match the source report for the full validation cycle.
verify: Re-run the comparison one final time after corrections.
Pass when every KPI ties to the source report.

steps.title: Publish the dashboard and confirm access permissions
sop: Publish the validated dashboard to the business unit's Power BI workspace.
Set workspace access permissions for the business unit's users.
Confirm a sample user can open the dashboard with the correct permission level.
Done when the dashboard is published and access confirmed for the business unit.
verify: Log in as a sample business unit user and open the dashboard.
Pass when the dashboard opens and displays correctly for that user.

steps.title: Confirm the completed work is filed and meets acceptance criteria
sop: Open Power BI workspace publish history for the business unit dashboard.
Confirm the required evidence for this task is present and complete.
Review the evidence against the task's documented acceptance criteria.
Done when the evidence is complete and meets the acceptance criteria.
verify: Reopen the evidence location and spot-check the filed evidence.
Pass when the evidence fully satisfies the acceptance criteria.

generic.Defined scope/population: The performance review meeting with finance, compliance and actuarial business partners.
generic.In-scope period: The most recently closed reporting period being reviewed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Meeting date, attendees, deck version and action items all populated in the minutes.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Number of logged action items matches the number discussed in the meeting.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed-off meeting minutes retained with meeting date and version number.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Action items without an accountable owner or date flagged for follow-up before filing.
generic.Test population: The performance review meeting minutes and action item list for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires every action item to have a named owner and target date before filing.
generic.Exception handling path: Unassigned action items are returned to the meeting organizer for owner assignment.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Meeting minutes with assigned owners and dates filed for the reviewed period.
generic.Evidence location: Operations Performance Report SharePoint folder, meeting minutes subfolder.

steps.title: Schedule the performance review meeting with business partners
sop: Open the shared calendar and identify a slot that works for finance, compliance and actuarial stakeholders.
Send the meeting invite with the performance review agenda attached.
Confirm acceptance from each required stakeholder group.
Done when the meeting is scheduled and accepted by all required stakeholders.
verify: Check the calendar invite responses.
Pass when finance, compliance and actuarial have each accepted.

steps.title: Circulate the performance report deck and dashboard link ahead of the meeting
sop: Attach the finalized performance report deck to the meeting invite or a pre-read email.
Include the live dashboard link in the same communication.
Send the pre-read at least the agreed number of business days before the meeting.
Done when the deck and dashboard link are circulated ahead of the meeting.
verify: Confirm the pre-read email or invite update was sent.
Pass when recipients received the deck and dashboard link before the meeting date.

steps.title: Capture discussion notes and action items in the shared minutes document
sop: Open the shared review meeting minutes document during the session.
Record key discussion points and every action item raised.
Note the accountable owner and target date proposed for each action item.
Done when the minutes capture all discussion points and action items from the meeting.
verify: Review the minutes immediately after the meeting for completeness.
Pass when every action item raised in the meeting appears in the minutes.

steps.title: Confirm each action item has an accountable owner and target date
sop: Review the minutes document line by line for owner and date fields.
Follow up with meeting attendees to fill any missing owner or date.
Update the minutes document once all fields are complete.
Done when every logged action item has both an owner and a target date.
verify: Re-scan the minutes document for blank owner or date fields.
Pass when no action item is missing an owner or a target date.

steps.title: File the signed-off meeting minutes in the SharePoint folder
sop: Route the completed minutes to the Operations Manager for sign-off.
Upload the signed-off minutes to the Operations Performance Report SharePoint folder.
Tag the file with the reviewed period and meeting date.
Done when the signed-off minutes are filed and tagged in SharePoint.
verify: Open the SharePoint folder and locate the filed minutes.
Pass when the minutes are present, signed off and correctly tagged.

steps.title: Confirm the completed work is filed and meets acceptance criteria
sop: Open Operations Performance Report SharePoint folder, meeting minutes subfolder.
Confirm the required evidence for this task is present and complete.
Review the evidence against the task's documented acceptance criteria.
Done when the evidence is complete and meets the acceptance criteria.
verify: Reopen the evidence location and spot-check the filed evidence.
Pass when the evidence fully satisfies the acceptance criteria.

generic.Defined scope/population: KPI definitions for every operations function covering cycle time, error rate, SLA adherence and unit cost.
generic.In-scope period: The KPI set as currently approved for ongoing use.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Calculation method, data source and target threshold populated for every KPI.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Number of KPIs in the catalog matches the number configured in the Power BI model.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: KPI catalog document retained with version number and sign-off date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: KPIs rejected or revised during review logged with the reason and resolution.
generic.Test population: The full draft KPI definition sheet circulated for leadership sign-off.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires every KPI approved with method, source and threshold documented and signed off.
generic.Exception handling path: Unapproved or disputed KPIs are revised and recirculated before being added to the catalog.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approved KPI set with calculation method, source and target documented and signed off.
generic.Evidence location: KPI catalog document in the BI/reporting platform governance library.

steps.title: Draft the KPI definition sheet by function
sop: Open the KPI definition template covering cycle time, error rate, SLA adherence and unit cost.
List each operations function and the applicable KPIs for that function.
Save the draft definition sheet to the shared KPI development folder.
Done when a draft KPI definition sheet exists covering all in-scope functions.
verify: Review the draft sheet against the list of operations functions.
Pass when every function has at least one KPI drafted for it.

steps.title: Define the calculation method, data source and target threshold for each KPI
sop: For each KPI, document the exact calculation formula.
Identify the system of record data source feeding the calculation.
Set the proposed target threshold based on historical performance or benchmark.
Done when every KPI has a method, source and target threshold documented.
verify: Spot-check three KPI definitions against the underlying source system.
Pass when the calculation method and source are confirmed accurate for the spot-checked KPIs.

steps.title: Circulate the KPI definitions for leadership review and sign-off
sop: Send the draft KPI definition sheet to operations leadership for review.
Collect and incorporate feedback into a revised definition sheet.
Obtain formal sign-off from operations leadership on the final KPI set.
Done when operations leadership has signed off on the final KPI set.
verify: Confirm a sign-off record exists from operations leadership.
Pass when the sign-off record is dated and references the final KPI set.

steps.title: Record the approved KPI set in the KPI catalog document
sop: Open the KPI catalog document in the BI/reporting platform governance library.
Add the newly approved KPIs with method, source and target populated.
Increment the catalog's version number and log the change.
Done when the catalog document reflects the approved KPI set at the new version.
verify: Compare the catalog document to the signed-off definition sheet.
Pass when every approved KPI is present in the catalog with matching definitions.

steps.title: Configure the approved KPIs as fields in the Power BI operations performance model
sop: Open the Power BI operations performance data model.
Add or update measures for each approved KPI using its documented calculation method.
Validate each new measure against a known sample value.
Done when all approved KPIs are configured as measures in the model.
verify: Test each new measure against the KPI catalog's documented calculation.
Pass when every measure's output matches the expected calculation result.

steps.title: Confirm the completed work is filed and meets acceptance criteria
sop: Open KPI catalog document in the BI/reporting platform governance library.
Confirm the required evidence for this task is present and complete.
Review the evidence against the task's documented acceptance criteria.
Done when the evidence is complete and meets the acceptance criteria.
verify: Reopen the evidence location and spot-check the filed evidence.
Pass when the evidence fully satisfies the acceptance criteria.

generic.Defined scope/population: Critical performance issues such as regulatory deadline misses and significant error spikes.
generic.In-scope period: The current escalation event and its immediate lead-up period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Ticket category, severity, description and supporting evidence populated on the escalation.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: One escalation ticket exists per confirmed critical performance issue.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Escalation timestamp and manager acknowledgment retained on the ticket.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Escalations without a follow-up owner logged and returned for assignment.
generic.Test population: All ServiceNow escalation tickets opened for critical performance issues in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires the ticket opened, routed, acknowledged and evidence attached within the SLA window.
generic.Exception handling path: Unacknowledged escalations are re-routed to the backup escalation contact.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Escalation ticket opened, routed and acknowledged with supporting evidence attached.
generic.Evidence location: ITSM platform escalation ticket for the performance issue.

steps.title: Confirm the performance issue meets the critical escalation criteria
sop: Review the trend chart or error report against the escalation matrix's critical thresholds.
Confirm the issue is a regulatory deadline miss or a significant error spike as defined.
Note the confirmed issue type and severity for the escalation ticket.
Done when the issue is confirmed to meet critical escalation criteria.
verify: Re-check the trend chart against the escalation matrix threshold.
Pass when the issue clearly exceeds the defined critical threshold.

steps.title: Open a ServiceNow incident ticket for the confirmed issue
sop: Open the ITSM platform and create a new incident ticket.
Enter the issue category, severity and a clear description of the performance issue.
Save the ticket and note the assigned ticket number.
Done when the incident ticket is created with category, severity and description.
verify: Open the newly created ticket and review its fields.
Pass when category, severity and description are complete and accurate.

steps.title: Attach supporting evidence to the ticket
sop: Export the trend chart or error report showing the magnitude of the issue.
Attach the exported file to the ServiceNow ticket.
Confirm the attachment is visible and downloadable from the ticket.
Done when supporting evidence is attached to the ticket.
verify: Open the ticket's attachments panel.
Pass when the trend chart or error report is present and opens correctly.

steps.title: Route the ticket per the escalation matrix and confirm acknowledgment
sop: Assign the ticket to the senior management escalation queue defined in the escalation matrix.
Notify the receiving manager directly if acknowledgment is not automatic.
Record the escalation timestamp and the manager's acknowledgment on the ticket.
Done when the ticket shows routing, timestamp and manager acknowledgment.
verify: Check the ticket's activity log for the acknowledgment entry.
Pass when the receiving manager's acknowledgment is timestamped on the ticket.

steps.title: Confirm the ticket remains open with a follow-up owner until resolved
sop: Assign a follow-up owner responsible for tracking the issue to resolution.
Set the ticket status to open with the follow-up owner as the assignee.
Review the ticket status periodically until the issue is closed.
Done when the ticket is open, assigned and tracked until resolution.
verify: Check the ticket assignee and status field.
Pass when the ticket remains open with a named follow-up owner until closure.

steps.title: Confirm the completed work is filed and meets acceptance criteria
sop: Open ITSM platform escalation ticket for the performance issue.
Confirm the required evidence for this task is present and complete.
Review the evidence against the task's documented acceptance criteria.
Done when the evidence is complete and meets the acceptance criteria.
verify: Reopen the evidence location and spot-check the filed evidence.
Pass when the evidence fully satisfies the acceptance criteria.

generic.Defined scope/population: All KPIs on the divisional performance dashboard compared to internal targets and industry benchmarks.
generic.In-scope period: The current reporting period's KPI results.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Gap size, trend direction and affected business unit populated for each flagged KPI.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Number of flagged gaps in the tracker matches the number of KPIs missing target beyond tolerance.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Performance-gap tracker retained with period, gap size and trend direction.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Previously flagged gaps without a documented resolution flagged for follow-up.
generic.Test population: All KPIs missing target or benchmark by more than the defined tolerance for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires every KPI missing target beyond tolerance logged with gap size and trend direction.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved prior-period gaps are re-opened in the tracker rather than dropped silently.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: All KPIs missing target documented with gap size and trend direction.
generic.Evidence location: Performance-gap tracker in the BI/reporting platform.

steps.title: Compare each KPI's actual result to its internal target and industry benchmark
sop: Open the current-period KPI results in the BI/reporting platform dashboard.
Pull the internal target and industry benchmark value for each KPI.
Calculate the variance between actual and each reference value.
Done when every KPI has a calculated variance against target and benchmark.
verify: Spot-check the variance calculation for three KPIs.
Pass when the spot-checked variances match manual recalculation.

steps.title: Flag KPIs missing target by more than the defined tolerance
sop: Filter the KPI list for variances exceeding the defined tolerance threshold.
Mark each qualifying KPI as flagged in the working analysis.
Confirm the tolerance threshold used matches the current governance standard.
Done when every KPI over tolerance is marked as flagged.
verify: Recheck the filter logic against the documented tolerance threshold.
Pass when only KPIs genuinely over tolerance are flagged.

steps.title: Document the gap size, trend direction and affected business unit
sop: For each flagged KPI, record the numeric gap size versus target.
Note whether the trend over recent periods is improving, flat or worsening.
Identify the specific business unit or function the gap affects.
Done when gap size, trend direction and business unit are recorded for every flagged KPI.
verify: Review the documentation against the underlying trend data.
Pass when the trend direction stated matches the actual multi-period trend.

steps.title: Log flagged gaps in the performance-gap tracker
sop: Open the performance-gap tracker for the current period.
Enter each flagged KPI's gap size, trend and business unit into the tracker.
Set an initial prioritization status for each logged gap.
Done when every flagged gap is logged in the tracker with a prioritization status.
verify: Compare the tracker entries to the flagged KPI list.
Pass when every flagged KPI has a corresponding tracker entry.

steps.title: Confirm no previously flagged gap was dropped without documented resolution
sop: Review the prior period's flagged gaps against the current tracker.
Confirm each prior gap is either resolved with evidence or still open and carried forward.
Flag any prior gap that disappeared from the tracker without documented resolution.
Done when every prior-period gap is accounted for as resolved or carried forward.
verify: Cross-reference the prior-period tracker export against the current tracker.
Pass when no prior gap is missing without a documented resolution.

steps.title: Confirm the completed work is filed and meets acceptance criteria
sop: Open Performance-gap tracker in the BI/reporting platform.
Confirm the required evidence for this task is present and complete.
Review the evidence against the task's documented acceptance criteria.
Done when the evidence is complete and meets the acceptance criteria.
verify: Reopen the evidence location and spot-check the filed evidence.
Pass when the evidence fully satisfies the acceptance criteria.

generic.Defined scope/population: SLA breaches, volume spikes and quality failures selected for root-cause investigation.
generic.In-scope period: The period during which the SLA breach, spike or failure occurred.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Confirmed root cause, contributing factors and cause classification populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Number of documented root causes matches the number of investigated issues.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Root-cause write-up retained with investigation date and analyst name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Issues where no root cause could be confirmed logged with next-step disposition.
generic.Test population: All performance issues referred for root-cause investigation in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires every investigated issue to have a documented, evidence-linked root cause.
generic.Exception handling path: Inconclusive investigations are escalated for deeper data analysis before closure.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Root cause documented and linked to the underlying SLA breach or quality failure record.
generic.Evidence location: Performance issue tracker, root-cause analysis attachment.

steps.title: Pull the transaction-level detail behind the issue
sop: Open the source system extract covering the SLA breach or volume spike period.
Filter the extract down to the specific transactions or records involved.
Save the filtered transaction detail to the investigation working folder.
Done when the relevant transaction-level detail is extracted and saved.
verify: Confirm the extracted transactions fall within the breach or spike window.
Pass when the transaction set matches the reported issue's time window and volume.

steps.title: Run a structured root-cause exercise with the affected process owner
sop: Schedule a working session with the affected process owner.
Apply a 5-why or fishbone technique to trace the issue back through contributing factors.
Capture the session's findings directly in the root-cause working document.
Done when the structured exercise produces a candidate root cause with supporting factors.
verify: Review the session notes for a clear causal chain.
Pass when the causal chain traces from the symptom to a specific root cause.

steps.title: Document the confirmed root cause and contributing factors
sop: Write up the confirmed root cause in the standard root-cause template.
List each contributing factor identified during the structured exercise.
Cross-reference the write-up against the transaction-level detail pulled earlier.
Done when the write-up documents the confirmed root cause with contributing factors.
verify: Review the write-up against the transaction detail for consistency.
Pass when the stated root cause is consistent with the underlying data.

steps.title: Distinguish systemic causes from one-off anomalies
sop: Review whether the root cause has recurred in prior periods using the performance issue tracker.

generic.Defined scope/population: Committed corrective actions arising from performance-gap and root-cause reviews.

steps.title: Follow up at the committed date to confirm implementation

Confirm whether the corrective action was implemented as described.
Update the tracker record's implementation status accordingly.

verify: Review the tracker record's status field after follow-up.
Pass when the status accurately reflects the owner's confirmed response.

steps.title: Pull the relevant KPI trend to verify post-implementation improvement
sop: Open the BI/reporting platform and pull the target KPI's trend since implementation.
Compare the post-implementation trend to the pre-change baseline.
Note whether the metric improved to the expected level.

Close the tracker record only if the metric shows the expected improvement.
Record the verification evidence in the tracker record before closing.

Pass when every closed record has attached evidence supporting the closure.

steps.title: Name the accountable process owner and core project team

steps.title: Route the charter to the Operations Manager for approval

Walk through each step, handoff and decision point in sequence.

Done when interview notes capture every step, handoff and decision point.
verify: Review the notes for gaps between consecutive steps.
Pass when the sequence is complete from process start to end with no missing handoffs.

steps.title: Draft the current-state map using SIPOC or swimlane notation
sop: Open Confluence and create a new current-state map page for the process.
Lay out the captured steps using SIPOC or swimlane notation as appropriate.
Label each swimlane with the responsible role or system.
Done when a draft map exists showing all captured steps in the chosen notation.
verify: Compare the draft map against the interview notes step by step.
Pass when every interviewed step appears correctly placed on the map.

steps.title: Validate the draft map with the process owner and performers
sop: Walk the process owner and named performers through the draft map.
Capture any corrections or missing steps they identify.
Update the map to reflect the validated version.
Done when the process owner and performers confirm the map is accurate.
verify: Re-walk the corrected map with at least one performer.

sop: Add cycle-time annotations to each step based on the interview data.
Mark steps identified as error-prone or high-rework during the interviews.
Confirm the annotations are visible on the published map layout.

verify: Review the annotated map for coverage of all flagged steps.

sop: Move the validated, annotated map page into the Confluence process library.

sop: Pull the pre-change baseline value recorded in the charter.

Close out the measurement step in the project record.
